title: Wonderful personal tour
text: William was an exceptional guide. His knowledge and years of expertise at the basilica made all the difference with the tour.  He met us and quickly began the tour even before we could enter.
author: James_K

title: Great experience....
text: Great experience. Daniella was a very knowledgeable and attentive guide. Enjoyed the opportunity to see the inside of Sagrada Familia.
author: David_S

title: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
text: I had previously visited Sagrada Família without a guide. This visit, Jaume, our tour guide, elevated the experience. Jaume was clearly passionate and well educated on this magnificent site. And, he didn’t overload us with unnecessary facts and details. I highly recommend him:
author: Mary_T

title: Paula was amazing!!
text: My partner and I loved our tour! Our guide, Paula, was so sweet and knowledgeable. We went at 9 am, which was perfect to avoid wild crowds and see the light shine through the stained glass.
author: Thomas_H

title: Informative tour of Sagrada Família by Alex
text:
We took a private tour of Sagrada Família this past Sunday. Someone from the company reached out to us a few hours before the scheduled tour time to confirm details and offered us and earlier time than we had booked, which we gladly accepted because we had a departing train to catch later that day. We received a Google Maps link to direct us to the meeting point, along with photos to help us locate our guide.

author: E4960JDjanl

title: Everyone needs to see...
text:
Everyone needs to see Sagrada Família.  It is a marvel of architecture and creativity. There is so much detail.  I’ve seen no other Catholic Church like this one.  I also recommend getting a guided tour.  Our guide, Daniela, was amazing.  She shared so much knowledge and pointed out details that we may not have otherwise recognized.  Every part of this building has history behind it.
You don’t want to miss this.
author: MaryBeth_R

title: Very lovely visit, pleasant, full of anecdotes away from the crowds.
text: Impeccable organization, schedules respected, kind assistance from another guide under the same brand to indicate to us which other guide was concerned. Paying more for a private tour outside of groups is an experience we will gladly do again.
author: Vincent_J

title: Lut was an excellent...
text: Lut was an excellent guide. Very knowledgeable. Pointed out lots of details. Highly recommended tour.
author: Elliot_K

title: Sagrada Família tour
text: Maria was a wonderful, knowledgeable guide. She was right on time and gave us interesting facts about Sagrada Família that we would not have found on our own. Doing a private tour is the best way to go.
author: Lynnette_B
